name: SS - Collection Orbit
description: Futuristic orbital carousel where collection cards are arranged in a 3D circular ring with smooth auto-rotation. Each card floats on the ring with perspective scaling – front cards appear larger, back cards fade and shrink. Click or hover to pause rotation. Features glow accents, glass-morphism card overlays, configurable orbit radius, rotation speed, and tilt angle. Ideal for modern, tech, and luxury brands.
author: Section Hub
